text: In the hollow base of an archangel statue, the elderly antique dealer Jesús Gris finds [a scarab-shaped mechanism built by an alchemist seeking eternal life|wants|cheating death and age]. Once wound, it grips him with spider-like legs and needles his skin, and soon his wrinkles fade, his vigour returns, and he [kneels to lick blood from a washroom floor|threat|blood drinkers]. A dying businessman sends his abused nephew Angel to take the device, while Gris's granddaughter Aurora watches him [sleep in a box to hide from sunlight|rules|it has a fatal weakness].
